messages.text: What are the most important signal generation capabilities for applications in AI?

### Short answer
The passages do not rank “most important” signal-generation capabilities for AI applications, but for generative-AI user-experience testing they explicitly support: controllable wireless network conditions, channel fading models, latency, jitter, RF impairments, and KPI measurement such as Time to First Token and Tokens Per Second using an R&S CMX500-based testbed [37][38][39][40].  
### Supported capabilities
| Capability | Why it matters for AI applications | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Configurable wireless network parameters | The generative-AI testbed uses the R&S CMX500 to configure network parameters while a smart terminal runs the client-side AI application and communicates with an LLM on the server or cloud side [37][40]. | [37][40] |
| Channel fading model generation / emulation | The R&S CMX500 testbed can configure channel fading models to evaluate generative-AI application behavior under diverse wireless environments [37][38][40]. | [37][38][40] |
| Latency and jitter control | The R&S CMX500 testbed can configure latency and jitter, and the testbed is used to compare how different network conditions affect generative-AI application responses [37][38][40]. | [37][38][40] |
| RF impairment control | The R&S CMX500 testbed can configure RF impairments and other variables for generative-AI user-experience testing [37][40]. | [37][40] |
| End-user KPI measurement for AI responses | The method quantifies generative-AI application user experience using Time to First Token and Tokens Per Second [39][40][41]. | [39][40][41] |
| Support for on-device generative-AI optimization | The testbed supports optimization of on-device generative-AI application design under different network conditions [38][40][41]. | [38][40][41] |
| Broad cellular test-platform coverage | The CMX500 is described as an all-in-one test platform supporting SA/NSA architectures, FR1 to FR3 up to 18 GHz, built-in IMS server, RF conformance, protocol validation, VoNR acoustics and carrier aggregation [40]. | [40] |
【推論】For AI applications that depend on wireless/cloud LLM interaction, the most relevant signal-generation capabilities are not only waveform creation but controlled network-condition generation: fading, latency, jitter, and RF impairments, because the cited testbed uses those variables to quantify TTFT/TPS and compare generative-AI response behavior [37][38][39][40].

R&S SMCV100B › 適用條件與規格定義
依 [[SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700]]，產品資料適用條件：

- 在 ambient temperature 儲存 `3 小時` 後，warm-up operation `30 分鐘`。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格定義：

- Specifications with limits：以範圍或限制值表示 warranted product performance，使用 `<, ≤, >, ≥, ±, maximum, minimum` 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits (`n. trc.`)：依 specifications with limits 測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：代表 warranted product performance，通常為尺寸或設定解析度等無或可忽略偏差的值。
- Typical data (`typ.`)：代表約 `80%` 量產儀器可達到的性能，或代表平均值。
- Nominal values (`nom.`)：代表性數值，不做 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試。
- Measured values (`meas.`)：來自個別樣品的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor = `2`，依 GUM 規則計算，考慮 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

R&S SMCV100B › Arbitrary waveform generator
| 條件 | Waveform length |
|---|---|
| Standard | `1 sample to 64 Msample`, one-sample steps |
| with `R&S®SMCVB-K511` | `1 sample to 512 Msample` |
| with `R&S®SMCVB-K512` | `1 sample to 1 Gsample` |

Sample rate：standard `400 Hz to 75 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K521` `400 Hz to 150 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K522` `400 Hz to 200 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K523` `400 Hz to 300 MHz`；HDD streaming standard `400 Hz to 75 MHz` 需 `R&S®SMCVB-K505`。

Arbitrary waveform mode RF bandwidth：standard maximum sample rate `60 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K521` `120 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K522` `160 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K523` `240 MHz`。Frequency offset setting range：standard `–30 MHz to 30 MHz`；with `K521` `–60 MHz to 60 MHz`；with `K522` `–80 MHz to 80 MHz`；with `K523` `–120 MHz to 120 MHz`。

Triggering and markers：trigger source internal 或 external；trigger modes auto、retrig、armed auto、armed retrig、single；external trigger input selectable from user 1 or user 2，`BNC female`，input level `0 V to 3 V nominal`，threshold `0.1 V to 2.0 V`，input impedance selectable `1 kΩ` or `50 Ω nominal`，trigger jitter `±1.67 ns`。Marker signals number `1`，operating modes unchanged、restart、pulse、pattern、ratio，level `LVTTL`。

Multisegment waveform mode：segments `1 to 1024`，changeover modes GUI、remote control、external trigger，sequencer play list length max. `1024`，segment repetitions max. `1048575`。

Multicarrier waveform mode：carriers max. `512`；total RF bandwidth standard `60 MHz`，with `K521` `120 MHz`，with `K522` `160 MHz`，with `K523` `240 MHz`。

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S SMM100A › 定位與用途
依 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]，[[R&S SMM100A]] 的主要能力包含：

- Frequency range：`100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- High output power：up to `+18 dBm`。
- Internal RF modulation bandwidth：up to `2 GHz`。
- 支援 5G NR signal generation for FR1 and FR2。
- RF frequency 與 modulation bandwidth 用於 future WLAN requirements。
- Excellent SSB phase noise、EVM、ACPR/ACLR performance。
- Internal real-time signal generation。
- Arbitrary waveform generator。
- Custom digital modulation。
- Keycode extendable bandwidth and ARB memory。
- Timed licenses、waveform packs、floating licenses。
- Structured GUI、touchscreen、block diagram operation、graphical signal monitoring in real time。
- Context-sensitive help system 與 SCPI recording。
- `R&S®SMM-K544` frequency response correction。
- Envelope tracking。
- High rate pulse（HRP）ultrawideband（UWB）。

依 [[R&S for JIO Project]]，[[R&S SMM100A]] 在 [[R&S WoMT 測試方案]] 中被簡報列為 RX sensitivity and blocking tests 的 signal source；但該簡報的 67 GHz frequency range 主張不得覆蓋正式 specifications。

R&S SMM100A › Jio WoMT use-case

- [[R&S SMM100A]] 被列為 [[R&S WoMT 測試方案]] 的 vector signal generator。
- Source slide 說 application 為 ultra-clean reference signals for RX sensitivity and blocking tests。
- 此 use-case 可追溯到 Market / project deck，不是 SMM100A 官方 application note 或 datasheet。
- 因該 slide 的 frequency range 與正式 specs 矛盾，引用 WoMT use-case 時不可引用 `up to 67 GHz` 作為 SMM100A 規格。

R&S SMW200A › Wideband baseband
- `R&S®SMW-B9` arbitrary waveform mode：waveform length `1 sample to 256 Msample`；with `K515` 到 `2 Gsample`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` sample rate：`400 Hz to 600 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `400 Hz to 1200 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `400 Hz to 2400 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` RF bandwidth：`500 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `1000 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `2000 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9F` 詳細 GNSS 規格見 `GNSS simulation for Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generators specifications`，文件 `PD 3607.6896.22`。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › Digital I/Q
- Standard digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K18`；wideband digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K19`。
- Digital I/Q input/output 可用於 [[R&S SMW200A]] 與其他 Rohde & Schwarz 儀器之間的 lossless connection，例如 [[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMM100A]]、[[R&S SMCV100B]] 或 CMW500 wideband radio communication tester 的 fading applications。
- DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface PAD-R`，level `LVDS`，connector `26-pin MDR`。
- HS DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R`，connector `QSFP+/QSFP 28`。
- Wideband HS DIG I/Q standard system configuration mode：40G up to `1.05 GHz`，50G up to `1.25 GHz`；advanced mode with `R&S®SMW-K822` input up to `500 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K823` input up to `1000 MHz`。

R&S SMBV100B › Enhancements
- R&S®SMBVB-K62 AWGN：C/N、Eb/N0 setting range depending on RF level，–50 dB to +45 dB；system bandwidth standard 1 kHz to 120 MHz，with extensions up to 1000 MHz，但高階 extension 條件需回 PDF 查核。
- R&S®SMBVB-K80 BER measurement：clock rate 100 Hz to 100 MHz；PRBS 9、11、15、16、20、21、23；measurement result in ppm、% 或 decade values。
- R&S®SMBVB-K80 BLER measurement：arbitrary data；CRC type CCITT CRC16；clock rate 100 Hz to 100 MHz。

- R&S®SMBVB-K548 Crest factor reduction：algorithm clipping and filtering；desired crest factor delta –20 dB to 0 dB。
- R&S®SMBVB-K811 Notched signals：up to 25 band-stop filters；supported with ARB、LTE、cellular IoT、custom OFDM。

CMX500 GPRF Generator
[[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] non-signaling use case：在 CMX500 上產生 ARB、CW、dual tone 或 replay `.wv` waveform，支援 R&D waveform replay / creation 與 standalone TX measurement 工作流。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › Signal types
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，GPRF Generator signal types 包含：

- ARB。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › Waveform replay
來源描述可 replay any waveform from：

- IQ capture。
- MATLAB。
- Other sources。

流程線索包含：

1. Convert with R&S MATLAB tools from App Note [[1GP60]]。
2. Read in complex IQ vector。
3. Add parameters（sample rate provided in `.info` file in CMX500 captures）。
4. Run conversion script from [[1GP60]]。
5. `.wv` stored in active directory。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Digital Design & Power / Energy saving
- Slide 14–15 將 highspeed digital and power designs 定位為需要快速、可靠、準確 T&M tools 的 verification / debugging 領域，測試工具包括 [[VNA]]、probes、phase noise analyzer、power supplies、multimeter、oscilloscopes、signal source。
- Slide 16 說 rising energy costs drive MNOs to boost efficiency，base stations and components offer substantial energy-saving potential。
- Slide 17 提出 optimization of power consumption、power statistics over time、device activity versus power consumption、real-time power / voltage / current statistics、up to 800 W / up to four channels；產品包括 [[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07 voltage probe、RT-ZC31 current probe。
- Slide 18 提到 measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers、envelope signal for tracker generated in real-time、turnkey solution based on VSG + VSA + SW、dedicated SW applications for Doherty、[[R&S SMW-K546]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K18]]。
- Slide 19 提出 PA load-pull testing，用於確認 PA 在 final design 看到不同 impedance 時的 behavior。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › 與既有知識的關係

- 補強 [[5G NR Base Station Conformance Testing]]：來源再次確認 5G NR base station conformance testing 從 conducted 到 OTA 的 R&D 脈絡，並提到 [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]]、test case wizard 與 transmitter / receiver / performance tests。
- 補強 [[R&S ATS1800C]] 與 [[R&S PWC200]]：來源提供 2025 MWC sales / solution view，特別是 PWC200 1.5 m vs 23.5 m 的 far-field / near-field 說法與 ATS1800C 30 cm quiet zone。
- 補強 [[O-RU testing]]：既有頁面只有 link hub，這份來源新增 integrated solution、C/U/S/M planes、O-TMA、VSE、FSW / FSVA3000、SMW200A / SMBV100B、PVT360A、3GPP TS 38.141 / O-RAN WG4 與 ETSI ES 202 706-1 energy efficiency testing 的簡報層級資訊。
- 連接 [[FWA CPE 測試與驗證]] 與 [[Network Densification]]：來源把 FWA、mmWave radios、sub-6 small cells、repeaters 視為 densification use cases，但未提供 FWA CPE 標準、型號或測試矩陣。

- 正式發布日期只可確認 MWC 2025 語境；簡報版次、作者與文件代碼未標示。
- `COMPANY RESTRICTED` 標示代表使用時需注意資料分類；本 ingest 只保留來源內容，不推論可公開散布範圍。

- [[R&S CMPHEAD30]] 的 RF bands 29 / 39 / 47、QDART validation、parallel DUT testing 與 path correction 為簡報說法，仍需 datasheet 或 production test 文件補證。

CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09 › 重點摘要

文件用途是提供 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 test applications overview；詳細描述需參考 **CMP180 help** 或 **user manuals**。量測範圍與 tolerance limits 不在本文件內，需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**。文件聲明為：**Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding.**

本文件涵蓋以下功能分類：

- Global options
- Bluetooth® options
- CDMA2000 options
- GSM options
- LP-IoT options
- LTE options
- NB-IoT options
- NR options
- Spectrum analysis options
- UWB options
- WCDMA options
- WLAN options
- R&S VSE options
- Ordering information

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › Shuffler
來源描述 [[Shuffler]]：

- RF / T-put test on all supported UE band combos in one go。
- All Shuffler tests part of [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] test package。
- Loop blocks provide flexibility to loop through bands、bandwidth、channels。
- one test script with one test report can test RF TX / RX measurement、RX sensitivity measurement、throughput、VoLTE / VoNR。
- Band combinations input via UE capabilities or user-defined Excel sheet。
- Shuffler implemented in [[R&S CMsequencer]]。

此處仍需正式 [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] 文件補證。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › toolchain
來源列出的 CMX500 toolchain 包含：

- [[R&S CMsquares]]。
- [[R&S CONTEST]]。
- Conformance：LTE、NR、2G、3G、C-IoT。
- 測試範圍：RF Conformance、RRM、LBS、NetOp、PCT、signaling tests、application、callbox、NPT、PQA、3GPP RF preconformance、ATE。
- 相關設備：[[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S ATS CATR]]、[[R&S NGM200]]、[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing
[[CMX500 use-case based 5G testing]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 market / solution positioning：以 use-case based approach 支援 5G eMBB、FWA、RedCap、NTN、XR 等裝置測試，而不只是一組單點工具。

Generative AI user experience testing › Testbed architecture
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and China Mobile Research Institute jointly demonstrate generative AI user experience testing]]：

1. [[Large language model]] 部署在 server side 或 cloud。
2. [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester 與 smart terminal 建立 radio connection。
3. Smart terminal 執行 client-side test application。
4. [[R&S CMX500]] 配置 network parameters、channel fading models、latency、jitter、RF impairments and other variables。
5. User 在 terminal-side application 輸入 prompts。
6. Terminal 接收 LLM inference responses。
7. Host PC software 收集與分析 data，並產生 charts。

Generative AI user experience testing › 測試目的
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and China Mobile Research Institute jointly demonstrate generative AI user experience testing]]，industry still lacks mature metrics and standardized test frameworks for evaluating user experience of generative AI applications；[[3GPP]] 與 [[GTI]] 等組織正在進行 related research。

本來源中的 testbed 目標是：

- 在 diverse wireless environments 下量化 end-user experience。
- 比較不同 network conditions 對 generative AI application response 的影響。
- 支援 on-device generative AI application design optimization。
- 為 future network optimization 提供 reference points。
- 支援 [[6G-enabled AI technologies]] 的 evolution、validation and standardization。

Generative AI user experience testing
[[Generative AI user experience testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and China Mobile Research Institute jointly demonstrate generative AI user experience testing]] 中描述的測試方法：在可控制的 wireless network conditions 下，以 [[Time to First Token]]、[[Tokens Per Second]] 等指標量化 generative AI application 的 end-user experience。

Rohde & Schwarz and China Mobile Research Institute jointly demonstrate generative AI user experience testing › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[China Mobile Research Institute]] 在 [[MWC Shanghai 2026]] 展示一套 generative AI applications 測試 solution。
- 來源稱此 solution based on the [[R&S CMX500]] 5G one-box signaling tester，可在 diverse network conditions 下首次量化 measurement end-user experience of generative AI applications。
- 測試架構中：
  - [[Large language model]] 部署在 server side 或 cloud。
  - [[R&S CMX500]] 與執行 client-side test application 的 smart terminal 建立 radio connection。
  - [[R&S CMX500]] 可配置 network parameters、channel fading models、latency、jitter、RF impairments 等 variables。
  - 使用者透過 terminal-side application 輸入 prompts，接收 LLM inference responses。
  - Host PC software 收集與分析 data，並產生 charts。
- 來源列出的 key performance indicators 包含 [[Time to First Token]]（TTFT）與 [[Tokens Per Second]]（TPS）。
- 來源稱此方法可支援 optimization of on-device generative AI application design，並提供 future network optimization 的 reference points。
- 來源把 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 all-in-one test platform，支援 SA / NSA architectures、FR1 to FR3（up to 18 GHz）、built-in IMS server、RF conformance、protocol validation、VoNR acoustics 與 carrier aggregation。
- [[Liu Guangyi]] 的引述把此 testbed 連到 6G-enabled ubiquitous intelligent connectivity、native network computing capabilities、new AI service metrics 與 testing methodologies。
- [[Jin Hailiang]] 的引述把此 testbed 描述為 generative AI user experience testing 的 benchmark，並指向 future test scenarios、industry use cases 與 standardization。
- 展示地點：China Mobile’s 6G Zone，Hall 3，N3E60。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。

R&S SMCV100B › I/Q modulation
- Operating mode：internal baseband I/Q。
- RF modulation bandwidth 最大 signal bandwidth 取決於 baseband option configuration：`8 kHz < f ≤ 240 MHz` 為 `±50% of carrier frequency`；`f > 240 MHz` 為 `±120 MHz`。
- RF frequency response：standard up to `120 MHz RF modulation bandwidth` 為 `< 3.5 dB`、`< 2.5 dB measured`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K547`、optimization mode high quality、up to `240 MHz RF modulation bandwidth` 為 `< 1.2 dB`、`< 0.3 dB measured`。
- Carrier leakage：mode internal baseband I/Q，referenced to full-scale input，`< –60 dBc`、`< –80 dBc measured`。
- Image sideband suppression：entire instrument in modulation bandwidth，up to `240 MHz RF modulation bandwidth`，`> 80 dB measured`，圖中少數頻率除外。
- Modulation error ratio：`> 40 dB measured`；測量條件為 single carrier waveform signal、`8 Msample/s`、root raised cosine rolloff、`α = 0.20`、`64QAM`、`level = 0.0 dBm`。
- Internal baseband characteristics：aliasing filter 具 amplitude、group delay、sin(x)/x correction；bandwidth rolloff to `–0.1 dB` 為 `250 MHz nominal`。

### Short answer
The passages do not rank “most important” signal-generation capabilities for AI applications, but for generative-AI user-experience testing they explicitly support: controllable wireless network conditions, channel fading models, latency, jitter, RF impairments, and KPI measurement such as Time to First Token and Tokens Per Second using an R&S CMX500-based testbed [37][38][39][40].  
### Supported capabilities
| Capability | Why it matters for AI applications | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Configurable wireless network parameters | The generative-AI testbed uses the R&S CMX500 to configure network parameters while a smart terminal runs the client-side AI application and communicates with an LLM on the server or cloud side [37][40]. | [37][40] |
| Channel fading model generation / emulation | The R&S CMX500 testbed can configure channel fading models to evaluate generative-AI application behavior under diverse wireless environments [37][38][40]. | [37][38][40] |
| Latency and jitter control | The R&S CMX500 testbed can configure latency and jitter, and the testbed is used to compare how different network conditions affect generative-AI application responses [37][38][40]. | [37][38][40] |
| RF impairment control | The R&S CMX500 testbed can configure RF impairments and other variables for generative-AI user-experience testing [37][40]. | [37][40] |
| End-user KPI measurement for AI responses | The method quantifies generative-AI application user experience using Time to First Token and Tokens Per Second [39][40][41]. | [39][40][41] |
| Support for on-device generative-AI optimization | The testbed supports optimization of on-device generative-AI application design under different network conditions [38][40][41]. | [38][40][41] |
| Broad cellular test-platform coverage | The CMX500 is described as an all-in-one test platform supporting SA/NSA architectures, FR1 to FR3 up to 18 GHz, built-in IMS server, RF conformance, protocol validation, VoNR acoustics and carrier aggregation [40]. | [40] |
【推論】For AI applications that depend on wireless/cloud LLM interaction, the most relevant signal-generation capabilities are not only waveform creation but controlled network-condition generation: fading, latency, jitter, and RF impairments, because the cited testbed uses those variables to quantify TTFT/TPS and compare generative-AI response behavior [37][38][39][40].

- [[Generative AI user experience testing]]：本來源核心測試方法，量化不同 wireless network conditions 下 generative AI application 的 end-user experience。
- [[Time to First Token]]：本來源列為 key performance indicator，縮寫 TTFT。
- [[Tokens Per Second]]：本來源列為 key performance indicator，縮寫 TPS。
- [[Large language model]]：testbed 中部署於 server side 或 cloud 的 generative AI model。
- [[On-device generative AI applications]]：來源稱可透過此 testbed 在不同 network conditions 下評估與最佳化。
- [[6G-enabled AI technologies]]：來源引述中的 standardization / validation 目標語彙。
- [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]]：本來源延續 CMX500 / FR3 / up to 18 GHz 的 PR 層級說法，但未明示 [[RFU18]]。
